# Phase 4: recent form + Logistic Regression (dev data only; auto-generated by src/run_phase4.py)

Eligible tour-level matches 2015-2024: **25,373** (dev 2015-2023: 22,560; validation 2024: 2,813). All models are scored on exactly these rows. **2025/2026 were not read.** Primary visibility rule: tournament-completion (PLAN.md M1).

## 1. Elo K re-selected under the strict rule (dev 2015-2023)

| K | general Elo dev log loss | surface Elo dev log loss |
|---|---|---|
| 16 | 0.6191 | 0.6262 |
| 24 | 0.6183 | 0.6229 |
| 32 | 0.6200 | 0.6228 |
| 48 | 0.6270 | 0.6272 |

Chosen: general K=24, surface K=32. (Phase 3 chose 24 and 32 under the group rule.)

## 5. Calibration, validation 2024

No post-hoc recalibration was applied. Slope < 1 = too extreme (overconfident); intercept is on the logit scale. These are diagnostics, not corrections.

|---|---|---|---|
| A: Elo baseline | 0.0348 | 0.009 | 0.834 |
| B: LR Elo | 0.0127 | 0.008 | 0.986 |

## 6. Impact of the conservative tournament-completion rule

Same hyperparameters, same Elo K; only the visibility rule changes. `group - strict` > 0 means the strict rule scores slightly *better*; < 0 means it costs accuracy.

| model | val LL strict | val LL group rule | group - strict | 95% CI | dev-fold LL strict | dev-fold LL group |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A: Elo baseline | 0.6248 | 0.6240 | -0.0009 | [-0.0020, +0.0002] | 0.6264 | 0.6253 |
| B: LR Elo | 0.6214 | 0.6211 | -0.0003 | [-0.0013, +0.0007] | 0.6209 | 0.6203 |
| B+: + ranking | 0.6178 | 0.6174 | -0.0004 | [-0.0012, +0.0004] | 0.6153 | 0.6147 |
| C: + recent form | 0.6161 | 0.6142 | -0.0019 | [-0.0044, +0.0006] | 0.6145 | 0.6124 |
